resources.string: The app connects to the server built into this device. Access from your home network is configured separately.

Open the classic TorrServer web interface from a phone or computer on the same network. The server keeps running when the app is in the background. Changing this setting restarts the server and is unavailable during playback.
Connect your TV device to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to see the address.
Enter this address in a browser on another device on the same home network.
Connected to an external server. Its owner controls starting and stopping it.
The APK does not include a TorrServer executable for this device.
TorrServer exited before it was ready.
TorrServer stopped unexpectedly. Start it in Settings.
Could not start TorrServer. Check whether the port is available and the APK supports this device.
Start server when the device boots

Autostart keeps the server running in the background with a notification. Open the app at least once after installation. After a force stop, Android blocks autostart until you open it again. Device restrictions may require permission to run in the background. If notifications are blocked, Android 13+ shows the service in the active apps list.
The current process manager does not support running as root. The built-in server runs without root.
Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment. A reverse proxy base path is supported.
Enter a port from 1024 to 65535 (the peer port also accepts 0 for automatic selection).
Address saved, but the connection failed. Check the server and try again.
Stop playback before changing the server address, settings or state.
The server denied access (HTTP 401/403). Use a server accessible without authentication.
This server does not support the required API.
TorrServer request timed out. Check the connection again.
Invalid response. Check that the address points to TorrServer.
Could not complete the operation. Check the connection and server state, then try again.
Android restricted background startup or the service stopped. Open the app and check background permissions in device settings.
TorrServer is running in the background
Downloads 8 MiB of test data from the server. For localhost, this measures the connection inside the device, not internet or torrent speed.
Average speed of the entire HTTP request, including headers. This short test gives an approximate measurement.
The server does not provide test data. Only response time is shown.
Could not measure speed: transfer error or timeout. Only response time is shown.
Torrent engine settings on the selected server
TorrServer will reset all engine settings, including those not shown here, and recreate the torrent engine. Active torrents will be reset. This operation runs on the selected server.
API reset is verified for MatriX.146.1. Use the web interface for other versions.
The server will recreate the torrent engine and reset active torrents, including those used by other clients. Playback will be interrupted. A full process restart is usually unnecessary.
Saving recreates the torrent engine and resets active torrents. Settings cannot be changed during playback.
Load the current server settings. Only supported fields are shown.
Enter a number from %1$d to %2$d in the units shown in the label.
TCP and uTP cannot both be disabled.
The server did not confirm saving. The database may be read-only. Reload current values.
Server confirmed saving. Torrent engine recreated.
Server confirmed reset. Torrent engine recreated.
Settings saved. Restart the built-in server to update its process memory limit.
In-memory cache. Larger values require more free RAM on the TV device.
Time before disconnecting a torrent with no readers.
0 for automatic selection, or a port from 1024 to 65535.
0: do not add; 1: add; 2: remove; 3: replace.
This setting takes effect after saving to the server.
Source priority · first match is used
When enabled, AniList is checked first.
No camera: open the address above in a browser and enter this code
70–110%, in 5% steps. Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.

Could not check or download the update. Check your connection and try again.
Latest TorrServer: %1$s. The built-in server updates with the APK; an external server is updated by its owner.
Enter the Android TV app GitHub repository as owner/repository and save the settings.
The app is up to date.
No compatible ARM APK was found in the latest release.
The release does not include a SHA-256 checksum for the APK.

APK exceeds the allowed size limit.

Allow installation from TorrFrame in Android system settings, then return and install the update.
The system APK installer is unavailable on this device.
Could not read saved settings. Check storage access and restart the app. Saved data has not been deleted.
No local Wi-Fi or Ethernet network
Connect your phone to the same local network and scan the QR code with its camera. The link is single-use and valid for 2 minutes.
Link expired. Refresh the QR code.
New QR code and pairing code
Use a trusted local network. HTTP traffic is not encrypted. The port is not automatically exposed to the internet. Disabling the module revokes all sessions.
Could not start Phone Remote. Check whether the port is available and the app may run in the background.
Choose a port from 1024 to 65535, different from the TorrServer port.
No active player on the TV.
Open TorrFrame on the TV, then try playing the film again. Android restricts opening screens from background apps.
Operation failed. Check settings and connection.
Control TorrFrame over your local network. Open settings.
Settings changed on another device. Review current values and save again.
The poster and description will be removed from this card. The film and viewing history will be kept.
Phone Remote stopped, but settings could not be saved. Check storage and try disabling it again.
Playback changed on the TV. Refresh player state and try the command again.
Search result expired. Search again and select the torrent or metadata.
HTTP is not encrypted. Use a trusted network.
Server settings changed. Reload current values and repeat your changes.
Playback failed. The file, connection or codec may be unavailable. Press Back to try another file.
Could not start the player. Press Back to return.
Temporary test tools. Reset when the app process restarts. Saved keys, settings and files are kept.

Changes apply to new requests. Refresh the catalog or a film’s metadata. A simulated failure automatically bypasses that source’s cache so it cannot hide the error. Caches are kept. TorrServer simulation blocks API requests without stopping its process.
Start TorrServer in Settings to load the library and watch films. Saved films remain in your library.
Checking the server connection. Saved films remain in your library.
Could not load the library from TorrServer. Check the server address and network connection, then select Refresh. Saved films remain on this device.
No compatible external players found. Install a player that supports network video.
The selected player is no longer available. Choose another player or use the built-in player.
Could not open the external player. Choose another player or use the built-in player.
Resume, audio and subtitles in an external player depend on that player. Phone playback controls are available for the built-in player.
Could not open subtitles. Use SRT, ASS/SSA, VTT or TTML files up to 8 MB.
No document picker on this device. You can enter an HTTP/HTTPS subtitle URL.
Applies to the next playback session. Video uses device decoders with automatic fallback.
Depends on the display and system settings. A display mode change may briefly blank the screen.
Jackett search will be available here later.
App process memory and CPU, graphics memory and network errors. Updates every 2 seconds while the screen is visible. Off by default; resets on process restart.
DNS: could not resolve the server address.
HTTPS: secure connection failed. Check the date and certificates.
The server did not respond in time.
Could not connect. Check the network and access to this address.
The server response could not be processed.
The server rejected the key or authentication.
Request limit reached. Try again later.
The server returned an HTTP error.
Enter HTTPS endpoints you are authorized to use. The API base must include /3/; image bases precede /t/p/. Empty endpoints are not used.
The public tmdb.cub.best catalog does not require a token. Leave the URL empty to use it. A custom URL and token are optional.
Remove CUB token and select TMDB
Check the HTTPS endpoints. Proxy mode requires an API endpoint and a mirror. The change was not saved.
TMDB is the default. Automatic mode uses CUB if TMDB fails. CUB may return Russian titles. Full details and related titles still use TMDB.
Show favorites at the top of the catalog
Show Watch later at the top of the catalog
Recreates the main screen and replays the splash. Slow loading delays UI readiness for at least 7 seconds. Data and caches are kept; the app process is not restarted.
